title: Mini hoop art piece
subtitle: A small composition designed to display in a 10 cm hoop
excerpt: A mini hoop art piece is a small embroidery worked specifically to live in the hoop as a finished piece, with the hoop acting as both frame and mount.
heroPrompt: Mini embroidery hoop art, a small sprig of leaves and berries in muted greens and reds on cream linen, finished in a 10 cm hoop displayed against white wall, natural light.

content.text: A mini hoop art piece uses the 10 cm hoop as its frame, so the design is planned from the start to fit within it. The back is finished neatly so the piece can go straight on the wall.

items.label: Fabric
items.value: Cream linen or cotton, 15 x 15 cm

items.label: Thread
items.value: 2 to 3 colours of stranded cotton, 2 strands each

items.label: Hoop
items.value: 10 cm wooden embroidery hoop (this is the finished frame)

items.label: Finishing
items.value: Small piece of felt and fabric glue for the back

content.text: Draw a simple design that fits within the hoop circle: a leaf sprig, a simple flower, or a small botanical. Keep it compact so the design reads clearly at this scale.
Transfer the design to the fabric. Mount in the 10 cm hoop and tension firmly.
Embroider the design using the stitches the design calls for. At mini scale, stem stitch outlines and French knot fills work well.
Remove transfer marks. Do not remove from the hoop.
Trim the fabric to about 3 cm outside the hoop edge. Fold the excess fabric to the back of the inner ring and glue or running-stitch it in place. Cut a felt circle and glue over the back to finish.
Hang by tying a ribbon around the top of the hoop screw.
